task: Repeated simultaneous local constraint messages over a fixed target-resource incidence graph; no child graphs, branch decisions or assignment enumeration in inference
input: Root frozen common corpus --corpus path; rows with targets,resources,columns bitmasks; use eval and structure partitions only
labels: Root offline maximum_matching and feasible; independent audit-only augmenting matching verifies labels and retained edge support, never imported by inference
variables: One Boolean for every original allowed edge; each target exactly one chosen edge; each resource at most one
main: Synchronous monotone Boolean support propagation. Every row and capacity factor reads previous-round domains; outputs intersect only after all factor messages computed. No in-place wave, matching call, assignment choice or graph expansion.
scan: Save states0..32 to measure first certified status and first fixed point; no new input appears after round0
shuffled_control: Fixed seed1729 row-specific resource relabeling preserves row degrees but deliberately changes shared identity. Certificates concern modified graph only; any comparison to original labels is an untrusted ablation, never a valid original-graph proof. A consistent global resource permutation would be an isomorphism, not this ablation.

contract.FEASIBLE: Only an explicit complete injective selection of forced edges
contract.INFEASIBLE: Only empty edge-domain, target zero candidates/multiple forced choices, or resource multiple forced choices from valid local deductions
contract.UNKNOWN: Neither certificate; cannot imply feasibility or infeasibility

controls_contract: Original-graph controls remain sound partial solvers; shuffled control's raw statuses are explicitly untrusted for original graph
metrics: per-family/depth FEASIBLE INFEASIBLE UNKNOWN and false certificates
proof dependency radius versus stationary repeated pass
CPU wall time with literal round budget

timing.sample: first512 eval roots and allstructure roots
timing.runtime: Python3 standard library, matched implementation, exploratory not engine performance

limits: CPU only; no engine/model/training/GPU; 32 iterations; tiny corpus outputs, no per-root bulky traces except selected examples
hypothesis: A forced chain of n targets needs2n-1 synchronous rounds to certify all choices: additional rounds extend dependency radius. Ambiguous cycles and Hall-deficient non-singleton cores may reach a fixed point UNKNOWN; support propagation is not complete matching.
